items.title: Fungal infection cluster at Sydney hospital linked to deaths of two patients
items.description: The cluster of infections at the transplant unit at the Royal Prince Alfred Hospital late last year saw two people die, health bosses say.

items.title: Hundreds of women join support group in wake of claims against gynaecologist
items.description: More former patients of Melbourne gynaecologist Simon Gordon have come forward to express distress over their treatment with many joining a newly-formed private support group.

items.title: 'A patronising cop out': Grace Tame responds to PM 'difficult life' apology
items.description: Grace Tame criticises Prime Minister Anthony Albanese's qualified apology after he described her as "difficult", saying "what a patronising cop out".

items.title: Rescuers abseil down 350m cliff to reach hikers stranded in alps
items.description: Emergency service crews have conducted a 24-hour rescue mission, involving 350 metres of a vertical climb, to locate two hikers who became stranded on a ledge in the Snowy Mountains.

items.title: Former New Zealand prime minister Jacinda Ardern moves to Australia
items.description: Jacinda Ardern had been living with her family in the US, but a spokesperson says they are now "basing themselves out of Australia".

items.title: Teen confirmed as first Australian death from tick-induced red meat allergy
items.description: Jeremy Webb's death in 2022 is the first documented fatal case of mammalian meat allergy in the country and second in the world.

items.title: One word unravels Albanese's week
items.description: The prime minister was this week evacuated from the Lodge over a bomb threat and later got stuck in a tit-for-tat with a former Australian of the Year.

items.title: Greg Lynn 'cannot possibly' have fair retrial this year, lawyers argue
items.description: The Supreme Court of Victoria hears the former Jetstar pilot's application to be bailed ahead of his retrial over the alleged 2020 murder of Carol Clay in Victoria's High Country.

items.title: Children in camp for IS-linked families speak about attempt to get to Australia
items.description: The children of women with ISIS links stuck in a Syrian refugee camp talk about their attempt to leave last week, saying they dream of one day buying toys and ice cream in Australia.

items.title: Wieambilla property where officers died for sale in 'dilapidated' state
items.description: The property where two Queensland police officers were murdered has been put up for sale, with photos showing the house in a state of disrepair.

items.title: 'I felt my spine vibrate': Perth student describes terrifying lightning strike
items.description: A Perth teenager has described the terrifying moment she was injured by a lightning strike on a school tennis court, saying she felt her "spine vibrate" after a bolt ricocheted into her and a friend.

items.title: Mother and daughter discover contender for world's largest known coral colony
items.description: Mother and daughter citizen scientists have found what is believed to be the largest coral colony on the Great Barrier Reef and possibly in the world.

items.title: Australians will receive mobile alert in July under new emergency trial
items.description: Most Australians will receive a mobile phone alert in July this year, as part of a nationwide test of a new emergency warning system.

items.title: How a gun fight on a speedboat may have foiled an explosive terror plot
items.description: Cuban coastguard troops shot dead four people and injured six others they claimed were approaching the country on a speedboat filled with weapons set to be used in an act of terror.

items.title: INXS nominated for induction into Rock & Roll Hall of Fame
items.description: INXS will be considered for induction into the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame and is one of 10 first-time nominees on the ballot.

items.title: Preaching kindness, Amanda Seyfried went all in on her latest role
items.description: The Oscar-nominated star adored working with director Mona Fastvold to resurrect an astonishing religious figure in The Testament of Ann Lee.

items.title: From the first Mardi Gras to RuPaul, do you know your queer history?
items.description: Australia's LGBTQIA+ history is full to the brim with groundbreaking art, brave protests and lots of fun along the way. Test how much you know about the queer trailblazers of our country in this quiz.

items.title: Daylesford man, 51, charged with alleged assault of solo female hiker
items.description: A Daylesford man has arrested and charged after solo female hiker was allegedly assaulted in central Victoria.

items.title: 'Sledgehammer to crack a nut': Activists go to court over NSW protest laws
items.description: The demonstrators are arguing in the state's highest court that the laws introduced by Premier Chris Minns after the Bondi Beach terror attack should be ruled unconstitutional.

items.title: 'Lives at risk': Senator fears Triple Zero system failing after deaths
items.description: A Senate committee hears bombshell testimony about Optus's processes during an outage that led to the deaths of multiple customers who were unable to call Triple Zero.

items.title: Man found guilty of killing wife in Perth 40 years ago
items.description: A jury in the murder trial of Raymond Reddington, 79, finds him guilty of killing wife Sharon Fulton 40 years ago, despite a body not being found.

items.title: National bushfire outlook puts NSW, Victoria and southern WA at heightened risk
items.description: The latest seasonal bushfire outlook has identified large parts of Victoria, NSW and southern WA as still at risk, even though summer is almost over.

items.title: Suspected serial offender linked to IS walks free over filmed gay bashing
items.description: A suspected serial violent homophobe linked to an Islamic State terrorist network has walked free on probation after pleading guilty to a brutal snuff-video-style gay bashing.

items.title: Subcontractor jailed for fatal gas mix-up at Sydney hospital
items.description: Newborn John Ghanem died, while baby Amelia Khan suffered severe and permanent brain damage when they were inadvertently given nitrous oxide instead of oxygen after their births.

items.title: Trump says Muslim congresswomen should be removed from US over speech clash
items.description: US President Donald Trump says two Muslim Democratic politicians should be sent back to "where they came" from after a heated exchange during his State of the Union address.
